learning_outcomes.text: The student can independently search, review, and understand documentation (Manual, Tutorial, ...).
The student can develop and document a design based on requirements.
Students can apply web techniques in an embedded context.
The student is able to troubleshoot errors, both on the client and server side.
The student is able to contextualize the discussed protocols (What are they for / How to set them up or use them to ...).

assessment_methods.method: Oral evaluation of assignments (Webservices & Applications: Lab)

assessment_rules: The overall grade is on a scale of 1-20. The 'Webservices & Applications: Theory' component is assessed via a written exam (100%). The 'Webservices & Applications: Lab' component is assessed via an oral evaluation during the examination period of the various assignments (including the group assignment) performed during the semester (code + configuration + servers + services + documentation). Partial transfers are possible for successful component results within the academic year. For resits, students must contact the lecturer to obtain a remediation assignment to replace the group work.
